text:
Elena: quick note  weekly KPI snapshot shows webinar->MQL rate dip today, NA cohort mostly. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/weekly/webinar_kpis :eyes:

Mark: saw that. overall registrants steady but MQL conversion down ~15%. could be a routing or scoring change.

Rita: ran a small sanity sql to compare event payloads before/after the scoring roll yesterday:
```
SELECT event_time, has_score, score_version, count(*)
FROM events.webinar_register
WHERE day='2026-04-02'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Nate: FYI we rolled scoring v2 at 03:30 UTC with stricter thresholds (score>=0.7). that likely reduced automatic MQL tagging.

Elena: ah ok. was that rollout scoped? thought it was a canary for dedicated accounts only.

DevOpsBot: deploy: scoring-service v2 promoted to prod at 2026-04-02T03:30:12Z by nate. rollout policy: 100%.

Mark: that explains it. action items: 1) Nate revert rollout to 10% canary and rollback full promotion; 2) Rita reprocess yesterday's window with old scoring to estimate impact; 3) Elena add a note to Friday KPI review with numbers and recommended wording. target: snapshot before EOD.

Nate: rolling back full promotion now. reverting promotion to canary 10%. ETA 5m. :racehorse:

Rita: will run reprocess job and post delta. quick estimate: if we restore previous scoring, MQLs go up ~13% in the day window.

KPI-Bot: alert logged: scoring_rollout_impact detected (z=5.2) at 2026-04-02 03:45 UTC. linked note: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/notes/3187654321-note

Elena: perfect. Nate pls confirm once rollback finished and share a short blurb for the weekly deck (root cause, impact, mitigation). Mark pls include an item to add a pre-promotion KPI check in the rollout playbook.

Nate: rollback complete at 2026-04-02T03:36:10Z. posted short blurb to /shared/marketing/rollouts/3187654321.md.

Mark: added playbook task MKT-5012 (pre-promo KPI smoke test).

Elena: thanks team. we'll include the before/after numbers in Friday's review and mark this as a process learning rather than product change. closing thread unless anything else. :lock:
